business.title: Challenges → beneficiaries & losers

business.body:
- Ag-tech platform combining hyperspectral imaging (HSI) drone analytics with a farmer advisory and food-traceability ecosystem, addressing pest/disease/nutrient-driven crop losses and residue-related export rejections (over 16% of India's EU farm exports were rejected for exceeding maximum residue levels).
- Proprietary in-house hyperspectral spectral-index development and AI/agronomic-validation R&D let it read each material's unique 'spectral signature' from drone imagery, detecting crop stress, pests and nutrient deficiencies invisible to the naked eye or an RGB camera.
- Two-pillar revenue model: CropAssure (drone-based crop-monitoring subscriptions plus agri-input commissions) and SourceAssure (trading arbitrage/premiums on residue-free produce with embedded farm-to-pack traceability).
- Successfully listed on BSE SME (Scrip Code 544535), which the company positions as strengthening its transparency and governance.
business.title: Positioning (investor deck)

business.body:
- [Ecosystem/R&D] Introduced affordable hyperspectral imaging in India to let research institutes run HSI research programs, positioning BharatRohan as an enabler of the broader domestic HSI ecosystem.
- [Board] Board led by MD & Chairman Amandeep Panwar and Whole-Time Director & CTO Rishabh Choudhary, with independent directors drawn from CSR, banking/finance, Bayer APAC commercial consulting, and ICAR-NAARM agri-research backgrounds.

outlook.title: Growth verticals / optionality

deepdive.thesis: BharatRohan has scaled its CropAssure platform to 2 lakh acres with 55K farmers, monetizing via subscriptions, input sales, and produce trading, while launching a consumer brand for residue-free agri-products; the key inflection is the DGCA-certified Pravir-X6 drone enabling franchise-led spraying services and expansion into non-agri sectors like solar and pharma.
